name: Etched Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, the Etched Sigil calls new night elf hunters to their trainer.

sections.title: Summons of the Wilds
sections.body: Newly awakened night elf hunters receive the Etched Sigil as they enter Shadowglen. Its carved marks of the hunt carry a welcome and summons from Ayanna Everstride, the hunter trainer who lives high in Aldrassil’s hollowed boughs. The token sends each novice to seek her out and begin instruction in archery, wilderness tracking, and the night elf bond between stalker and beast.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Etched Sigil?
aliases: why do i have this sigil
faq.answer: The Etched Sigil summons a novice night elf hunter to seek Ayanna Everstride in Aldrassil and begin instruction in survival, tracking, and archery.

aliases: where did etched sigil come from
faq.answer: Ayanna Everstride, the hunter trainer in Shadowglen, sends the Etched Sigil.

faq.q: Where should the sigil be taken?
aliases: where do i bring etched sigil
who do i give etched sigil to
faq.answer: Bring the sigil to Ayanna Everstride atop Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

faq.q: Why do night elf hunters receive a sigil rather than a paper letter?
aliases: why a sigil instead of letter
what is the sigil made of
faq.answer: The entry gives no reason for using a carved token instead of a paper letter.

angles.text: As a hunter, the Etched Sigil marks the start of your training in the bow and the ways of beasts under Ayanna Everstride.
As a night elf, you receive the sigil in Shadowglen, among the canopy traditions of night elven foresters who safeguard Teldrassil.
